description.narrative: IFC expects the Project to contribute to Romanias green energy transition by adding 288 MWp of wind capacity. The Project will also contribute to improved competitiveness by demonstrating the viability of a hybrid offtake structure without government support in a market where generation is dominated by SOEs, while enhancing resilience by diversifying the energy mix and ensuring long-term energy security.

The proposed investment would support the development of the 288 MW Dunarea greenfield onshore wind power plant in Constanta County, Romania (the Project). 211 MW of its overall capacity were awarded 15-year Contract-for-Difference (CfD) under Romanias support scheme with the balance expected to operate in the competitive electricity market on a merchant basis.
